title: Juniper and the Veil
author: R. M. Amberdale
blurb: Beatrix Okafor, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
